# Golden IFC corpus

Round-trip fixtures for `scripts/golden-roundtrip.mjs` (CI workflow
`.github/workflows/golden-roundtrip.yml`). The harness parses every `*.ifc`
file in this folder twice, diffs entity-class counts, and compares the result
against the golden snapshot in `snapshots/<file>.ifc.json`. A mismatch fails CI.

## Current state (2026-11-21)

The corpus contains **38 `.ifc` fixtures** (plus one `.ifczip` archive):
**14 self-authored valid fixtures** generated by
`scripts/generate-ifc-corpus.mjs` (extends `scripts/generate-ifc.mjs`), **15
valid extended fixtures** under `extended/` (generated by
`scripts/generate-ifc-corpus-extended.mjs`), **5 invalid-model fixtures**
consumed by `test:ifc-semantics` and the fuzz gate `test:fuzz-ifc`, and **4
malformed fixtures** consumed by `test:step-preflight`:

| Fixture | Schema | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `generated-small.ifc` | IFC4 | 2 walls + 1 door (hosted opening) + 1 slab |
| `generated-2x3.ifc` | IFC2X3 | same model, IFC2X3 schema |
| `generated-structural.ifc` | IFC4 | 1 beam + 1 column |
| `mep-model.ifc` | IFC4 | 2 ducts + pipe + cable tray + conduit + AHU equipment, 2 storeys |
| `arch-classified.ifc` | IFC4 | arch model + Uniclass-style classifications (4 elements) |
| `spatial-hierarchy.ifc` | IFC4 | 3 storeys, 4 IfcSpace rooms, site→building→storey tree |
| `structural-2x3.ifc` | IFC2X3 | columns, beams, pad + strip footings, diagonal brace |
| `mep-systems.ifc` | IFC4 | 3 ducts, 2 pipes, tray + conduit, 2 AHUs, 2 storeys |
| `property-sets.ifc` | IFC4 | per-element properties (typed values), materials, quantities |
| `units-imperial.ifc` | IFC4 | length unit FOOT (conversion-based, 0.3048 m), not SI METRE |
| `geometry-complex.ifc` | IFC4 | L-stair, ramp, railing, curtain wall, gable roof, baseboard sweep, slab void |
| `relationships.ifc` | IFC4 | voids/fills, space aggregate, materials, classification |
| `arch-2x3.ifc` | IFC2X3 | walls, hosted door + window, slab, column, 1 space |
| `scale-grid.ifc` | IFC4 | 4 storeys x 8 bays, 100 elements (largest corpus fixture) |
| `model.ifczip` | IFC4 | STORE zip of `spatial-hierarchy.ifc` (fixed timestamp) |
| `invalid/bad-guid.ifc` | IFC4 | GlobalId outside the base64 alphabet |
| `invalid/dangling-ref.ifc` | IFC4 | relationship references a missing entity |
| `invalid/missing-units.ifc` | IFC4 | unit assignment removed |
| `invalid/truncated.ifc` | IFC4 | file cut mid-DATA |
| `invalid/duplicate-guid.ifc` | IFC4 | two walls share one GlobalId |
| `malformed/*.ifc` (4) | IFC4 | parser-hang regressions, issue #231 — see `malformed/README.md` |

All valid fixtures are generated from the platform's own authoring writer —
no third-party license constraints. `node scripts/golden-roundtrip.mjs`
reports `14/14 pass` on the top-level valid fixtures. The `invalid/` and
`malformed/` subtrees are intentionally not scanned by the golden gate. The
invalid fixtures are consumed by `test:ifc-semantics` and the fuzz gate
`test:fuzz-ifc` (which seeds on the top-level valid fixtures plus
`invalid/`); the malformed fixtures are consumed by `test:step-preflight`
(they must be rejected before web-ifc). See
`docs/IFC_COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md` for the capability matrix these
fixtures back.

## Manifest and extended corpus (added 2026-11-21)

`manifest.json` is the machine-readable index: every `.ifc` under this folder (38 files) is listed with kind (valid / invalid / malformed), schema, source, licence, purpose and expected result; `tests/ifc-corpus-manifest.test.cjs` fails if a file is unlisted or behaves differently from its declaration. `extended/` (15 valid files, IFC4 + IFC2X3: rooms, 4 storeys, structural frame, MEP, stairs/ramp/railing, curtain wall/roof/ceiling, hosted openings, spaces, STEP-encoding, 400-wall stress, classification) is generated by `scripts/generate-ifc-corpus-extended.mjs`.

**Limit:** all valid files were produced by this project's own writer (`independent: false` in the manifest). They test the readers on many entity classes and shapes, not interoperability with Revit/ArchiCAD/Tekla exports. Licensed third-party models are still needed for #96. `extended/` has no golden web-ifc snapshots yet (web-ifc could not run where these were generated).

## Coverage

Every fixture's coverage is recorded in the manifest. Across the corpus
the §12 categories are covered as follows: IFC2X3 (`generated-2x3`,
`structural-2x3`, `arch-2x3`), IFC4 (all other valid fixtures),
architecture, structural, MEP, spatial hierarchy, property sets, units
(`units-imperial`), geometry complexity, relationships, invalid fixtures.
Known gap, recorded in the manifest: the writer emits no `IfcSystem`
grouping, so MEP *system membership* is not covered — `mep-systems.ifc`
covers MEP segments and equipment only.

## Regenerating

```sh
node scripts/generate-ifc-corpus.mjs   # rewrites top-level fixtures + manifest.json (deterministic)
node scripts/golden-roundtrip.mjs      # writes snapshots for new valid fixtures — commit both
npm run test:ifc-corpus-manifest       # manifest ↔ files drift check + per-fixture expectations
```

Do not add a fixture by hand without a manifest entry: the manifest test
fails if a listed file is absent, if an unlisted `.ifc` appears under this
folder, or if a file behaves differently from its declaration. `.ifczip`
archives are not listed in the manifest (the test walks `*.ifc` only) and
are covered by `test:step-preflight`. External models may only be added
with a clear open licence recorded in the manifest; when in doubt, generate
a synthetic equivalent with the project's own writer instead.

## Per-entity fidelity reports (#106)

`per-entity-reports/` holds one deterministic JSON per fixture plus
`summary.json`, generated by `node scripts/ifc-per-entity-report.mjs`
(`npm run report:ifc-per-entity`) and guarded by
`tests/ifc-per-entity-corpus.test.mjs`, which fails on drift. Measured on
main (2026-11-21, web-ifc 0.0.77 cross-check): 9/11 files reported, 69
products — 65 preserved / 2 transformed (both `IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE` →
`IfcWall`) / 1 approximated (wall left uncontained by the dangling
containment relationship) / 1 failed (project with an invalid GlobalId).
The 2 unreported files are the `malformed/` fixtures, which yield no
readable products. The web-ifc leg matched every reported GlobalId with
the same type (69/69, 0 missing, 0 mismatched).

Known corpus discrepancy surfaced by the report, not fixed here:
`generated-structural.ifc` is described above as "1 beam + 1 column" but
contains no `IFCCOLUMN` — 5 products (project, site, building, storey,
beam), all preserved. Correcting the fixture (or its description) is
separate work; the report measures the file as it is.
